_note: Online play, from the council's New Player Primer and the Discord. Times are US Pacific; the page converts them to the reader's time zone.

weeklies.name: Webcam Weekly
weeklies.blurb: Paper cards (or proxies) on your own table, played over a camera. It's the closest thing to playing in person.

weeklies.name: Cockatrice Weekly
weeklies.blurb: Played on Cockatrice, where every card ever printed is free to use. A good first tournament if you're still building your paper deck.

leagues.name: Webcam Async League
leagues.format: Four rounds of Swiss or a round robin, then Top 8.
leagues.note: Same as the weekly, just on your own schedule.

leagues.name: Cockatrice Async League
leagues.format: Four rounds of Swiss or a round robin, then Top 8.
leagues.note: All you need is a computer.

leagues.name: MTGO Async League
leagues.format: Play five opponents of your choice, or a round robin, then Top 8.
leagues.note: For people who already have a collection on MTGO.

clients.name: SpellTable
clients.desc: Wizards' free webcam table that runs in your browser. Point a camera at your play area and go.

clients.name: Convoke
clients.desc: Another free webcam option, with card recognition built in.

clients.name: Cockatrice
clients.desc: Free and open source, with every card. Great for testing a list before you buy anything.

clients.name: Magic Online
clients.desc: Wizards' digital client, used for the MTGO league. A lot of Canlander staples are much cheaper here than in paper.
